title: Children of Men
synopsis: Eighteen years of infertility, a London under refugee crackdown, and a woman in a barn who is the first impossible mother.

nodes.text: A TV announces the death of the youngest person on Earth. A bomb takes the cafe's front.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Run.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Help the wounded.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A friend with a battered car, two joints, a wife who does not move.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Heart.
You commit to “Leave at dawn.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Your ex from the old protest days, with a small ask in a kidnapped van.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Heart.

nodes.text: A burning car, a girl behind a back seat, a quiet that becomes a scream.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Panic” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Bullet through the throat in a country lane.

choices.text: Pull her out of the car
choices.consequence: “Pull her out of the car” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Loyal.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cold.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Heart—follows you into whatever comes next.

Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: A doctor takes Kee and the baby up the gangway and a sailor wraps your wound and the gray sea keeps doing what it does, indifferent, and saving.
You lie back in the boat and the fog goes pink at the edges and the world is, for one breath, a thing that has been started over.
You wake up in the cottage and Jasper is at the door with a teapot and the war is over and the baby in your arms grins at the ceiling.
